## Manager review -> approved cart (DEMO, orders nothing)
The reorder agent writes **cart-review.csv**: one line per proposed cart line. The practice manager writes **approve**, **change** (with approved_packs) or **remove**, plus name, time and a short note.

This workflow takes every **new** decision, checks it, logs it (who / when / why, proposed -> final) and builds the **approved cart per supplier** from approved and changed lines only. Lines without a decision wait. Lines already in the approval log are never processed again.

**Nothing is ordered** and no supplier is contacted.

### Going live (not built here)
The review sheet could be a shared spreadsheet, or an n8n Form with one line per item. Either way the rule stays the same: only approved lines reach the final cart, and every decision is logged.
